info.comment: IT'S FINALLY HERE, one of the most INCREDIBLE Sonic games on the site!*Y Scrolling*X Scrolling*Y Velocity*X Velocity*Paralax Scrolling Backgrounds which emulates classic Sonic games!*Slope detection which gives the player a realistic effect when climbing hills!*AI makes the game a realistic experience!*A full non-variable display scoring system!*Loops!*Dash tubes!*HD/32/16 bit graphics!*Rings!*Items!*Enemies!*Shields!*THREE FANTASTIC ZONES!CONTROLS: Use the arrow keys to move. Press the space bar to jump. Hold down and press space to start spinning. Press space repeatedly to rev up. Let go of down and you will perform the spindash.
